blocks.text: More than two decades after making history as Southeast Asia’s first wind farm, the iconic 52 MW NorthWind project in Bangui Bay, Ilocos Norte is demonstrating how strategic investments can maximize the performance and long-term value of renewable energy assets. ACEN has completed the second and final phase of the NorthWind Maintenance and Repair Program, a strategic asset optimization initiative that enhanced the performance, reliability, and long-term value of the landmark renewable energy facility. The initiative demonstrates how responsible investments in existing renewable energy assets can maximize their value while continuing to deliver clean electricity to the Luzon grid. As a […]...
